name: HARRY REID INTL

tower.source: FAA Digital Obstacle File 32-022333 (CTRL TWR, 370 ft AGL, 2433 ft AMSL)

about: The airport for the flight, built by scripts/build_airport.py, whose header is the full schema. Positions are metres east (x) and north (y) of the city origin, rounded to 0.1 m; elevations metres above sea level; directions degrees clockwise from grid north of the app frame unless named true. A polygon is {ring: [x0, y0, x1, y1, ...]}, counter-clockwise, first point not repeated, with clockwise holes only when present; a line is [x, y, ...]. runways and ends: FAA NASR (ends, thresholds, elevation profile, width, surface, marking and lighting codes, PAPI). pavement: the FAA's surveyed runway, taxiway and apron polygons (pieces overlap: draw them as one surface). taxiways: OpenStreetMap centre lines with names. stands: where the nose wheel stops and the heading there, with the lead-in line. gates, jetBridges, holdingPositions (dir: the taxiway's axis there, 0 to 180). lights: OpenStreetMap's mapped lights grouped by kind, colour where tagged and grid direction where tagged; lightKinds gives each kind's meaning and its colour by definition. buildings: the FAA's building polygons plus the OpenStreetMap terminals and hangars it lacks; h above the ground from LiDAR (the tower's from the obstacle file); inCity when the city's buildings.json already has it (do not draw those twice). tower and beacon from the FAA. sources: each source, its date, licence and credit line.

nasr.what: runways and runway ends, their marking and lighting codes, the beacon
nasr.credit: FAA National Airspace System Resource (NASR) 28-day subscription

faaAirportMapping.what: runway, taxiway and apron polygons, airport buildings, the beacon's position
faaAirportMapping.licence: FAA: "The data provided is for public use"
faaAirportMapping.credit: Federal Aviation Administration, Aeronautical Information Services: airport mapping data

faaObstacles.what: the control tower's position and height

osm.what: taxiway centre lines and names, stands, gates, jet bridges, holding positions, mapped lights, terminal and hangar names
osm.licence: ODbL 1.0 (this file is a derived database under the same licence)

lidar.what: building heights and the ground under them
lidar.datumNote: NASR runway-end elevations minus the LiDAR ground at the 8 ends (median); added to the LiDAR ground to give buildings[].ground
lidar.credit: U.S. Geological Survey, 3D Elevation Program (3DEP) LiDAR

cityBuildings.what: which airport buildings the city's set already has

source.datum: NAD 83 taken as WGS-84; heights above sea level
